sourceText: Continue implementing every Story in the accepted role-prompt modularization plan in order until all milestones are DONE, while validating recommendations with evidence and avoiding optimization for its own sake.
normalizedOutcome: Story 4 automatically and safely chooses incremental review only for mechanically proven bounded changes, otherwise selects full review, and prevents an incorrect incremental context from producing valid review evidence.
acceptanceClaim: For every supported and adversarial change class, the trusted runtime emits a deterministic eligibility decision and only envelope-bound evidence from the mechanically selected context mode can satisfy REVIEW and quorum consumers, while the advisory command remains read-only.
